title: Should India Scale i-Drone?
abstract: Should India scale i-Drone, the ICMR's drone delivery of vaccines and medical supplies? An ex-ante cost-benefit analysis of its five pilot districts in Manipur and Nagaland, benchmarked against Intensified Mission Indradhanush.
summary: An ex-ante cost-benefit analysis of i-Drone's five pilot districts. On vaccine delivery alone, a drone hub is 2.2 to 7.4 times less cost-effective than intensified outreach.

title: Comparing the Economic Contribution of Broadcasters and Foreign OTT Platforms in India
abstract: Do integrated domestic broadcaster-streamers add more economic value to India than foreign-controlled, subscription-first OTT platforms? Sony Pictures Networks India, Zee Entertainment, Netflix India and Amazon Prime Video compared.
summary: India's INR 2.78 trillion media sector, read through a Domestic Value Retention matrix: integrated broadcasters activate more of the value chain than foreign OTT platforms.
source: India Media Economy Research Report.docx, converted with tools/docx_to_html.py (four typos fixed by hand)
